questions.q: Why is the cohort size limited for the LLMOps course?
questions.a: This is the first cohort of a new intensive program. We're keeping seats limited to maintain quality, ensure direct instructor access, and gather feedback that will shape future iterations. Once spots are filled, they're gone.
